# 12 GTA Clip Archetypes

Each example is from the launch-week scout (2026-11-12 → 19). The numbers are vidIQ observations, not guarantees.

| # | Archetype | Trigger | Length | Footage needed | Live example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **First-Ever** ("World's first ___ in GTA 6") | FOMO, awe | 30–120s | own gameplay | Typical Gamer, "World's First Stolen Plane": 1.03M views in under 24h |
| 2 | **Chaos Escalation** ("I did X… then Y happened") | chaos, awe | Short or 8–12 min | own gameplay | GameV, "Stole a JUMBO JET… fighter jets came after me": 737K on a 320K-sub channel |
| 3 | **Streamer Reaction Roundup** | schadenfreude, belonging | 3–10 min | short credited excerpts + your commentary | Asmongold Clips, "GTA 6 just broke the internet": 411K vph, 8.5% engagement (the best in the scan) |
| 4 | **Versus / Comparison** (GTA 6 vs 5, PS5 vs Pro) | tribal debate | 8–10 min | own capture of both | GameV, "GTA 6 vs GTA 5": a 3× outlier. The keyword "gta 6 vs gta 5" is up 149% |
| 5 | **Map / Scale Tour** | awe | 8–15 min | own gameplay | "How BIG is the map?" The keyword "gta 6 map" has 725K/mo searches, up 129% |
| 6 | **Before You Buy / Verdict** | decision relief | 15–25 min | own gameplay | gameranx: 2.6M views in 20h |
| 7 | **Hot Take / Biggest Problem** | debate | 30–60s | any | Typical Gamer, "The Biggest Problem with GTA 6…" |
| 8 | **POV Life Skit** (no gameplay needed) | relatability | 8–20s | phone camera | Dimucc, "POV: Giving birth when GTA 6 drops": 1.1M. @rachdamico couple POV: 98× her median |
| 9 | **End-of-Era / Nostalgia** | nostalgia | 10–40s | archival plus text | "GTA 6 jokes are over" (1.06M). The keyword "gta 5 last ride" is up 634% |
| 10 | **NPC Reaction Edit** (movie clip plus "POV: GTA 6 NPCs") | humor | 8–15s | *licensed* or original footage | @rectic.exe: 33× median. Rights risk is high, so swap in your own gameplay |
| 11 | **Crossover Hijack** (a non-gaming niche rides the keyword) | curiosity | any | your niche's footage | Midwest Safety, "18-Year-Old Driver Thinks He's Playing GTA 6": 962K |
| 12 | **Tiny-Account Lottery Short** (simple emotional meme) | sympathy, humor | 7–18s | anything | "No GTA 6 for Nori": 1.44M views on a 6.9K-sub channel (208×) |

## Hook formulas that are winning right now
- "World's first ___ in GTA 6"
- "I ___ in GTA 6… then ___"
- "GTA 6 just ___ the entire internet"
- "POV: ___ when GTA 6 drops"
- "The biggest problem with GTA 6…"
- "GTA 6 vs GTA 5: ___"
- "How BIG is ___ in GTA 6?"

## Audio pattern (Shorts/Reels/TikTok)
Phonk or bass-boosted drops for chaos clips. Slow, sentimental music played ironically for life-skit POVs. Synth-wave for Vice City vibe edits.
